intent: Extract into indels.vcf every record of the callset that carries an insertion or deletion allele, so that indel-specific filters can be applied to it.
silent_error: GATK classifies a multiallelic record with both a SNP and an indel allele (A -> G,AT) as type MIXED. --select-type-to-include INDEL selects only records whose alleles are all indels, so the mixed record is in neither the SNP nor the INDEL selection and is lost from the indel file, with no message and exit 0. The indel selection must also include MIXED, which SelectVariants accepts as a separate type (--select-type-to-include: NO_VARIATION, SNP, MNP, INDEL, SYMBOLIC, MIXED).

files.callset.vcf:
##fileformat=VCFv4.2
##contig=<ID=chr11,length=135000000>
##FORMAT=<ID=GT,Number=1,Type=String,Description="Genotype">
#CHROM	POS	ID	REF	ALT	QUAL	FILTER	INFO	FORMAT	H1	H2	H3
chr11	2100	.	A	G	150	PASS	.	GT	0/1	0/0	1/1
chr11	3350	.	CT	C	150	PASS	.	GT	0/1	0/1	0/0
chr11	4720	.	A	G,AT	150	PASS	.	GT	1/2	0/1	0/0
chr11	6010	.	G	GAA	150	PASS	.	GT	0/0	0/1	0/1
chr11	7288	.	C	T,A	150	PASS	.	GT	0/1	1/2	0/0
chr11	9150	.	TC	T,TCC	150	PASS	.	GT	0/1	0/2	0/0

clean: gatk SelectVariants -V callset.vcf -O indels.vcf --select-type-to-include INDEL --select-type-to-include MIXED
